src/reviews.ts uses Decisions API and numeric probabilities in routeAnswer; there is no string matching (e.g., it checks answer.probabilities and thresholds, not out.toLowerCase().includes()).
The code uses a single choice question (src/review-question.ts) and the README says “One `choice` question defines mutually exclusive labels,” not separate noul questions for spam and abusive.
